---
title: "WRAT-5 Extractor"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf) # Requires Java
library(neuro2) # Your specific package
library(DT)

# Load the lookup table globally
# Use a relative path for portability, or ensure the file is in the same folder
if (file.exists("~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv")) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(
    "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  # Fallback if file is missing (stops app from crashing immediately)
  lookup_table <- data.frame(test = character(), scale = character())
}

# Ensure we handle the upload size if PDFs are large
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 30 * 1024^2)
```

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
#| label: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload PDF File", accept = c(".pdf"))
numericInput("pages", "Page(s) to Scan", value = 2, min = 1)

hr()

# Test Selection
selectInput(
  "test_code",
  "Test ID (matches lookup)",
  choices = unique(lookup_table$test),
  selected = "wrat5"
)

hr()
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download Clean CSV")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
#| label: fill

# UI for Column Mapping (Dynamic)
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")

# Output Table
DTOutput("table_display")
```

```{r}
#| label: server
#| context: server

# --- HELPER: Safe Number Parser ---
# Handles inputs like "<40", ">100", "105*" by stripping non-numeric chars
safe_parse <- function(x) {
  # Remove anything that isn't a digit or a decimal point
  clean_x <- gsub("[^0-9.]", "", as.character(x))
  as.numeric(clean_x)
}

# 1. Extract Tables
raw_tables <- reactive({
  req(input$file)
  validate(need(file.exists(input$file$datapath), "File not found"))

  tables <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
    file = input$file$datapath,
    pages = input$pages,
    method = "stream",
    output = "matrix"
  )
  req(length(tables) > 0)
  tables
})

# 2. Identify Candidate Table
candidate_table <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())

  best_idx <- 1
  max_matches <- 0

  test_scales <- lookup_table |>
    filter(test == input$test_code) |>
    pull(scale)

  if (length(test_scales) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  for (i in seq_along(raw_tables())) {
    mat <- raw_tables()[[i]]
    matches <- sum(mat %in% test_scales)
    if (matches > max_matches) {
      max_matches <- matches
      best_idx <- i
    }
  }

  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[best_idx]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  df
})

# 3. UI for Column Mapping
output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_table())
  df <- candidate_table()
  cols <- colnames(df)

  col_choices <- setNames(
    cols,
    lapply(cols, function(x) {
      val_preview <- paste(head(df[[x]], 2), collapse = ", ")
      paste0(x, " (e.g., ", val_preview, ")")
    })
  )

  wellPanel(
    h4("Column Mapping"),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "col_scale",
          "Scale Name:",
          choices = col_choices,
          selected = cols[1]
        )
      ),
      column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "col_raw",
          "Raw Score:",
          choices = c("None", col_choices),
          selected = cols[2]
        )
      ),
      column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "col_score",
          "Standard Score:",
          choices = col_choices,
          selected = cols[3]
        )
      )
    ),
          column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "col_ci_95",
          "95% CI:",
          choices = c("None", col_choices),
          selected = cols[4]
        ),

      column(
        6,
        selectInput(
          "col_percentile",
          "Percentile (Optional):",
          choices = c("None", col_choices),
          selected = cols[5]
        )
      ) # Guessing V5
    )
  )
})

# 4. Process Data (The Fix)
processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_table(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)

  df <- candidate_table()

  # A. Standardize Columns (Use safe_parse)
  clean_df <- data.frame(
    scale = df[[input$col_scale]],
    score = safe_parse(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # B. Join with Lookup (Filters garbage rows automatically)
  relevant_lookup <- lookup_table |>
    dplyr::filter(test == input$test_code)

  joined_df <- clean_df |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      relevant_lookup,
      # by = c("test" = "test", "scale" = "scale")
      by = c("scale" = "scale")
    )

  # C. Fix "Missing Column" Errors for Neuro2
  # We explicitly add these columns so neuro2 doesn't crash looking for them
  final_df <- joined_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      range = NA_character_,
      absort = NA_character_,
      description = NA_character_,
      result = NA_character_
    )

  # D. Apply Neuro2 Logic (Safely)
  if (exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    # Ensure test_type exists, default to "npsych_test" if lookup missed it
    if (!"test_type" %in% names(final_df)) {
      final_df$test_type <- "npsych_test"
    }

    final_df <- final_df |>
      neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(test_type = "npsych_test")
  }

  # E. Final Formatting
  final_df |>
    select(any_of(c(
      "test",
      "test_name",
      "scale",
      "raw_score",
      "score",
      "ci_95",
      "percentile",
      "range",
      "domain",
      "subdomain",
      "narrow",
      "pass",
      "verbal",
      "timed",
      "test_type",
      "score_type",
      "absort",
      "description",
      "result"
    )))
})

# 5. Outputs
output$table_display <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(processed_data(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0(input$test_code, "_results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    # Use standard write.csv to support row.names argument
    write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
)
```
